name: listNew
description: Creates a new list. With no arguments it returns an empty list; with a value it returns that value as a single-item list. The optional delimiters argument sets the list's delimiters. In RustCFML lists are plain delimited strings, so this is a convenience constructor over the string type.

params.name: delimiters
params.description: Optional delimiter string for the list.

examples.title: Single-item list
examples.description: Wrap a value in a new list.
